label: Feed
notes: what has been posted, with the camera as the page directly above the newest post. The `make` column that held the camera is gone.

label: Book
notes: the form and the receipts. The basket is on the Shop column.

label: Shop
notes: the shop: the basket on top, then the things for sale grouped by kind. RIGHT OF BOOKING, the other column you pay on. Find no longer has a Shop door.

label: Find
notes: the funnel. TAB_HOME — switching this one off leaves go('stuff') with nowhere to land.

label: You
notes: your account, and a page per person.

label: Settings
notes: your details, your username and your PIN. One page each. RIGHT OF YOU, because it was eleventh of eleven and reported as "I don't see it" — the one column you reach for from your own account card should not be four swipes past it.

label: Saved
notes: what you starred — widgets first, then anything else.

label: Spotlight
notes: what the business has put in the window — one list, the same on every phone, and only an admin can change it. AFTER SAVED, which is where it was asked for: the two read alike and the difference is whose list it is.

label: Progress
notes: a student's own record — what they have answered, what they got right, what to work on next. NOT BUILT YET: one card saying so, the same for everybody, and nothing on it to press. LAST, which is where it was asked for "for now" — moving it is this row's sort_order.
